title: fastpath: gated fast-path + precision toggle + safe-mode for KV/continuous-batching fallback
author: Ethan Miller
description: Motivation: reduce incorrect fast-path takes and mitigate correctness regressions while preserving most of the performance wins from fast kernels and lower-precision paths. Users have seen rare downstream quality blips when the fast-path executes under certain kv-cache edge cases or when scheduling results in truncated KV lifetimes. This PR introduces a gated fast-path with a runtime 'safe-mode' fallback and explicit precision toggles. Goals: 1) Add a low-overhead gating heuristic that prevents fast-path when KV or scheduling signals are out-of-profile. 2) Expose a user-configurable precision toggle (fp16/bf16/int8) at the request-route level and a runtime override for emergency safe-mode fallbacks. 3) Ensure KV-cache consistency across fallback transitions (fast->safe, safe->fast) and during continuous batching resizes. 4) Keep latency regressions minimal for the common case and provide clear telemetry to drive future gating thresholds.
commits: feat(runtime): add fastpath gating hook and heuristic scoring (E2E tests)
fix(kv-cache): reconcile cache state during fast->safe fallbacks to avoid stale KV lookups
feat(api): add precision toggle to route configs and SDK exposure
chore(tests): add regression tests for batching boundary conditions and cache handoff
perf(scheduler): prefer stable-slot allocations when gating is active
docs: document safe-mode behavior and recommended thresholds
files_snippets: cache_manager.rs: added reconcile_on_fallback(&mut self, fallback_meta) to replay/flush required kv entries
batcher.rs: early-exit when slot_lifetime < gated_threshold to trigger safe-mode
route_config.rs: pub enum Precision { FP32, FP16, BF16, INT8 } and route.precision: Option<Precision>
sdk route.py: expose Route(precision=...) and docs comment about safe-mode override
review_comments: Asha Patel: Overall design looks solid. Two asks: (1) ensure gate heuristics are configurable without restart, (2) we need a metric that counts fallback reasons (kv_stale/scheduler_pressure/precision_mismatch).
Ethan Miller (author): Added runtime-config for gate thresholds and emitted fallback.reason_count.{kv_stale,scheduler_pressure,precision_mismatch}. See runtime/metrics/mod.rs updates.
Miguel Santos: Concerned about reconciliation complexity—what's the worst-case latency when we replay KV entries on fallback?

Ethan Miller: We limit replay to keys referenced in the active batch window and do replay asynchronously while switching to safe kernels; worst-case tail adds ~1.2ms on a cold fallback in our perf harness. Documented in docs/fastpath-safe-mode.md
Lily Wang: Tests look good but please add a regression harness for rolling batching scale-down (continuous-batching shrink) — we saw a flake in staging earlier.
Ethan Miller: Added integration test fastpath_fallback_test.rs that simulates scale-up/down and asserts cache coherence and no output divergence across precision boundaries.
ci_checks: perf-canary: pass (p95 latency +0.8% on reg workloads, -15% token-cost on typical prompt mix)
notes_on_perf: Measured on p3dn-like instance in perf-lab. Fast-path still used in ~92% of requests for the measured workload after gating enabled.
p95 latency impact: +0.8% when gating enabled (tradeoff threshold), mean token-cost reduced by ~15% due to more aggressive int8 for eligible routes.
Cold-fallback penalty (first request when KV warmup required): ~1.2ms median tail as KV replay runs; subsequent requests amortize replay cost.
safety_and_correctness: Safe-mode: runtime override that forces fallbacks to stable kernels and full-precision paths. Intended as emergency kill-switch exposed via control-plane.
Precision toggle: per-route user control. Runtime will refuse to lower precision if model metadata marks it 'precision_sensitive'.
KV reconciliation: deterministic replay algorithm and idempotent write-through to avoid divergence across transitions.
release_notes: Runtime: introduce gated fast-path and safe-mode fallback for KV and continuous-batching to improve correctness while preserving fast-kernel benefits. Add per-route precision toggle; emit fallback reason metrics. Backward-compatible and opt-in via route config.
